tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The amount of a payment made to an eligible State or an eligible unit of local government for a year under this subpart shall be determined by the Secretary.

tree.heading: Continuing availability of funds after appropriation
tree.text: A payment made to an eligible State or eligible unit of local government under this subpart shall be available without fiscal year limitation.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 15422 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

ancestors.heading: payments to states and units of local government to assure access for individuals with disabilities
